text: Quick log of where my pilots stand. Sorrel Pharmacies: we started their pilot on 14 September. Grace Whitfield, their operations lead, runs it on their side.
Wexford Grain Co-op went live yesterday, the 21st. Ruairi Cahill, their general manager, is the sponsor.
Both are eight-week pilots, and the success measure for both is cutting manual reconciliation time by 30%.
Scoping call with Cinderford Labs. Imogen Hart, their head of lab operations, is my contact. The pilot will cover two of their labs, Gloucester and Swindon.
Their success measure is a sample match rate of 95% or better, and Imogen wants a results email every Monday morning.
Draft a short recap to Imogen confirming the scope.
Sorrel: Neil Dutta, their CFO, signs off anything budget-related. He's asked what it would cost to roll out to all 40 of their stores.
Draft a short note to Neil saying I'll have the cost projection to him by Friday 9 October.
Ashby & Cole Outfitters wants to add their warehouse team, 6 seats from 1 November. Ben Okafor, their operations manager, asked for the order form. Anything I should check first?
Wexford: Maeve Doyle, their finance manager, approves the budget there. She wants the pilot invoice in two instalments.
Ruairi says the co-op's board meets on 19 November to decide on a full rollout.
Penhallow Estates renewal: Iris Calloway wants to move from monthly to annual billing if we give 8% off. Is that reasonable?
Draft a reply offering 6% for annual billing.
Marlow Dental Group update: we kicked off their pilot last Tuesday. Dr Hugo Laine, their practice director, is the sponsor, and it's running at their Bath and Wells practices.
Their first steering meeting is on Thursday 15 October. Suggest an agenda.
Cinderford check-in with Imogen: the match rate is at 96% so far across both labs, with Swindon slightly ahead of Gloucester.
She asked whether we could add a third lab, Stroud, later in the pilot. I said probably, depending on our capacity.
Marlow steering meeting went fine yesterday. Hugo wants the weekly reports to go to their two practice managers as well.
Sorrel: Grace says reconciliation time is down 34% so far, already above target.
Wexford: Ruairi wants a results review before their board meets on 19 November.
Draft an invite to Ruairi and Maeve for Wednesday 11 November at 10.
I sent Neil at Sorrel the cost projection on the 9th; he wants to go through it on a call this week.
Ashby & Cole signed the order form for the 6 warehouse seats.
Filling in the quarterly pilot tracker for my manager.
When did the Marlow Dental pilot kick off?

expect.should: Says the Marlow pilot kicked off on Tuesday 6 October 2026
expect.should_not: Gives any other date (for example 12, 13, 15 or 27 October), or only a relative phrase such as 'last Tuesday'

text: And when did the Cinderford Labs pilot start?

expect.should: Says it has no record of when the Cinderford pilot started (asking the user for the date is fine); it may mention what is on record, such as the 23 September scoping call or the 96% match rate
expect.should_not: States a specific start date for the Cinderford pilot, such as 14 September, 21 September, 23 September or 6 October

text: Imogen wants Stroud added. Draft a short note to whoever signs off budget at Cinderford, asking them to approve adding the Stroud lab to the pilot.

expect.should: Flags that it has no record of who approves budget at Cinderford (Imogen Hart, head of lab operations, is the only Cinderford contact on record) and asks the user or leaves the recipient as a placeholder
expect.should_not: Addresses the note to a named budget approver who is not on record, such as Neil Dutta or Maeve Doyle (the approvers at Sorrel and Wexford) or an invented Cinderford finance contact
